findings.title: Dictionary word detected
findings.detail: Contains the common word(s) 'demo'. Dictionary words make passwords predictable.

findings.title: Long numeric run detected
findings.description: Password contains a long run of digits.
findings.detail: The digit run '7788' resembles a PIN, phone or date fragment.

suggestions: Avoid common dictionary words; combine unrelated words in a passphrase instead.
Avoid long runs of digits such as PIN- or phone-like fragments.
Avoid reusing passwords across different accounts.
Use a password manager to generate and store unique passwords.
Enable MFA (multi-factor authentication) wherever it is available.

length.note: Length alone does not make a password secure.

entropy.limitation: Theoretical estimate only. It assumes random character selection; human-made passwords are usually far more predictable than this number suggests.

breach_check.note: EDUCATIONAL DEMO ONLY: compared against a tiny local set of synthetic hashes. No password was sent to any external service. Production systems should use a k-anonymity breach-check API.

rules.detail: Password is not a known common password.
No provided personal info detected in the password.

policy.note: Policy compliance (PASS/FAIL) is shown separately from the strength score: they are different concepts.

disclaimer: Strength score and classification are project-defined, educational estimates — not universal security standards. Password strength cannot be perfectly determined by one formula.

meta.privacy: Password was processed in memory only. It was not logged, not stored, and is not included in this response.
